announcements.headline: Result of General Meeting
announcements.insight: This announcement confirms the outcome of a general meeting, which is a standard governance event for shareholders. It typically involves routine matters such as director reappointments or statutory approvals rather than significant strategic shifts.

announcements.headline: Result of AGM
announcements.insight: This announcement confirms the outcome of a general meeting, which typically involves routine shareholder approvals such as director reappointments or auditor appointments. It signifies standard corporate governance activity with no immediate indication of material financial or strategic change.

announcements.headline: 2026 Annual Report and Accounts
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies the publication of the company's annual financial results, which is a scheduled regulatory filing providing standard performance data to shareholders.

announcements.headline: Publication of 2026 Annual Report & Notice of AGM
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies the publication of annual results and the convening of a general meeting, which are routine governance events for shareholders. It typically involves voting on standard matters such as director reappointments and auditor remuneration.

announcements.headline: Director/PDMR Shareholding
announcements.insight: This announcement relates to director share dealings, which typically indicates routine insider trading activity rather than a significant corporate event. Such disclosures are standard regulatory requirements and generally carry low immediate impact on shareholder value.

announcements.headline: Preliminary Results for year ended 31 March 2026
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies the release of scheduled annual financial results for the company. It provides shareholders with the official performance data for the period ended 31 March 2026.

announcements.headline: Update on 2025 Annual General Meeting outcome
announcements.insight: This announcement provides the results of a scheduled shareholder meeting, which is a routine governance update. It confirms the outcome of resolutions put to investors without indicating any material change to the company's operations or financial position.

announcements.headline: Update on General Meeting voting outcome
announcements.insight: This announcement provides the outcome of a vote at a general meeting, which is a standard governance procedure. It confirms shareholder decisions but typically does not indicate immediate financial or strategic changes.
